arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one isolated full-body LILIPUTS.BMP game sprite. Image1 is the exact original for action, composition, silhouette, facing, limb paths, occlusion and every attached prop. Image2 is approved Cartoon worker IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, not its standing pose or its right-facing camera. FRAME 094: Wide braced rope pull. BOTH HANDS pull to screen LEFT, while the head keeps the original slight RIGHT turn with its right-side face visible. Do not aim his face left merely because his hands pull left. Higher hand at left chest height grips the tall upright rope; lower arm loops across abdomen to a lower left grip. Both arms belong to the same worker and remain visibly separate. Legs spread and knees bent in the source's strong stance. Rope continues far above the hands and pools/coils under and left of the feet. Entire rope endpoints and all shoes must fit comfortably inside the image, at least 8 percent clear transparent margin. Same worker identity: black cap, dark brown hair, tan skin, green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls with simple gold buttons, dark charcoal shoes, crisp black outlines and restrained cel shading. Keep the frame-specific pose and head direction described above. Trace each arm from its shoulder through elbow to hand, and each leg from hip through knee to shoe, with natural joints and source occlusions. Do not duplicate a sleeve or add a third limb. Rope where present is flexible warm golden-yellow/tan cord with a thin dark contour, no glow; preserve its path and grip contacts. Keep all original props and entire figure safely inside the canvas with clear margins. Genuine RGBA transparent background, no scenery, floor plane, shadow, halo, text or extra props. Do not copy the reference key's generic upright standing pose.
